question: 退款次数最多的商品是哪个
gold_sql: select p.product_name from refunds r left join order_items oi on r.order_id = oi.order_id left join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id group by p.product_name order by count(distinct r.refund_id) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT p.product_name
FROM refunds r
JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE r.status = '已退款'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
pred_sql:
